title: The Power of Small Words
text:
Many students struggle with connecting ideas in academic writing. However, linking words can make an argument much clearer. For example, 'therefore' signals a result, while 'nevertheless' introduces a contrast. Writers who use these connectors well help readers follow their reasoning from one point to the next.

Furthermore, reading widely exposes students to natural patterns of use. Consequently, teachers often recommend that learners practise connectors in short paragraphs before attempting long essays. Although connectors are small words, they carry a great deal of meaning. In short, mastering them is an essential step toward fluent academic writing.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what does the word 'therefore' signal?
According to the second paragraph, what do teachers often recommend?
options: Practising connectors in short paragraphs before long essays

questions.text: What can be inferred about writers who use connectors well?
options: They write shorter texts than other students
Their readers can follow their reasoning more easily
They avoid showing contrast in their arguments
They rely on sentences they have memorised

questions.text: Why does the author describe connectors as small words that 'carry a great deal of meaning'?
options: Because they are difficult to pronounce
Because they change the logical relationship between ideas
Because they are usually written in capital letters
Because they can replace whole paragraphs

paragraph_translations: Muitos alunos têm dificuldade em conectar ideias na escrita acadêmica. No entanto, os conectivos podem tornar um argumento muito mais claro. Por exemplo, 'portanto' indica um resultado, enquanto 'apesar disso' introduz um contraste. Escritores que usam bem esses conectivos ajudam o leitor a acompanhar seu raciocínio de um ponto para o outro.

Além disso, ler bastante expõe os estudantes a padrões naturais de uso. Por isso, os professores costumam recomendar que os alunos pratiquem os conectivos em parágrafos curtos antes de tentar redações longas. Embora os conectivos sejam palavras pequenas, eles carregam muito significado. Em suma, dominá-los é um passo essencial para uma escrita acadêmica fluente.
